The '''''Spirit of Commerce''''' was a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Ben Skywalker]] acquired passage on as a transport from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], where he would have a conversation with the ship's engineer who believed the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] to be savages and that he would shoot them all.
